documents.content:
Scope: circuit-alpha.
Declaration: I denotes branch current in circuit-alpha.
Declaration: V denotes the measured voltage in circuit-alpha.
Declaration: R denotes resistance in circuit-alpha.
Law statement: V = I R by Ohm's law.
Editing policy: I has another positive declaration in the inertia note, so definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are explicitly unavailable for I.

Scope: flywheel-study, disjoint from circuit-alpha.
Declaration: I denotes moment of inertia in flywheel-study.
The circuit note does not import this scope.

Declaration: q denotes the charge on sensor A.
No scope label is exported with this declaration.

Declaration: q denotes the charge on sensor B.
No scope label is exported with this declaration.

Declaration: U denotes electric potential energy.
Declaration: V denotes the applied voltage.
Law candidate: U = q V.
The unqualified q could denote either sensor charge; the note gives no discriminator.
Editing policy: duplicate positive declarations make definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename explicitly unavailable for q.

Shared scope: rig-7.
Declaration: P denotes total rig power.
Electrical law: P = V I.
The electrical channel reports 80 W.

Shared scope: rig-7.
Declaration: P denotes total rig power.
Mechanical law: P = F v.
The mechanical channel reports 50 W at the same instant.

Integration assertion: both declarations denote one and the same P, with no loss or storage term.
The simultaneous 80 W and 50 W assertions conflict.
Editing policy: the two positive declarations make definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename explicitly unavailable for P.

Declaration: Q denotes volumetric flow rate.
Declaration: A denotes duct area.
Declaration: v denotes mean velocity.
First relation: Q = A v.

Declaration: \Phi denotes mass flow rate.
Declaration: \rho denotes density.
Substitution uses the measured Q from the geometry note.
Derived law: \Phi = \rho A v.

Declaration: heat_rate denotes the wall heat-transfer rate.
Declaration: A denotes wall area.
Declaration: \Delta T denotes the temperature change.
Declaration: L denotes wall thickness.
Partial relation: heat_rate = A \Delta T / L.
The conductivity has not been supplied, so the conduction derivation is incomplete.
Editing policy: heat_rate is a multi-letter identifier, not an eligible single-letter or control-sequence symbol; definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are explicitly unavailable.

correctionSummary: Recorded the explicitly missing conductivity placeholder as the incomplete catalog role without treating it as grounded proof.

documents.content: Declaration: u denotes cross-section-averaged bulk velocity.
Declaration: u denotes local centerline velocity.

Declaration: Q denotes volumetric flow rate.
Declaration: A denotes cross-sectional area.
Derived candidate: Q = A u.
The derivation says only 'use the reported velocity', so u has two possible entities.
Editing policy: the duplicate declarations make definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename explicitly unavailable for u.

Verified guard: Pr(B) > 0.
Declaration: A denotes the alarm event.
Declaration: B denotes the baseline event.

Declaration: p denotes the conditional probability result.
Guarded law: p = Pr(A intersection B) / Pr(B).

Declaration: P denotes pressure.
Declaration: V denotes volume.
Declaration: n denotes amount.
Declaration: R denotes the gas constant.
Declaration: T denotes temperature.
Candidate law: P V = n R T.

Required guard: the sample is an equilibrium ideal gas.
Status: equilibrium has not yet been checked; no contrary evidence is recorded.

Declaration: C denotes capacitance.
Declaration: V denotes capacitor voltage.
Guard assertion: passive sign convention is active.
Active equation: I = C dV/dt.
Guard assertion: reverse-current sign convention is also active for the same terminals.
Active equation: I = -C dV/dt.
The measured derivative dV/dt is verified nonzero throughout the reviewed interval.
Both guards are asserted simultaneously, so the current claims conflict.
Editing policy: I has no positive explicit source declaration; definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are explicitly unavailable for I.

correctionSummary: Added a verified nonzero voltage derivative so the opposed sign-convention claims are genuinely contradictory.

documents.content:
Declaration: F denotes the net force on the cart.
Declaration: m denotes cart mass.
Declaration: a denotes cart acceleration.
The balance gives F = m a.
This force F is the quantity discussed in the conclusion.

Declaration: y denotes the measured output.
Declaration: C denotes the output matrix.
Declaration: x denotes state.
The measured quantity is the signal just declared.
It is modeled by y = C x, while the feedthrough matrix and control input are not supplied.

correctionSummary: Recorded the explicitly unsupplied feedthrough matrix and control input as incomplete catalog roles.

documents.content: Declaration: v denotes vehicle speed at the axle.
Declaration: v denotes air speed through the test section.

Declaration: P denotes mechanical power.
Declaration: F denotes applied force.
The memo says, 'use that speed.'
Law candidate: P = F v.
The phrase 'that speed' has two live antecedents, leaving v entity-ambiguous.
Editing policy: the duplicate declarations make definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename explicitly unavailable for v.

Declaration: A::x is an opaque foreign-interface key, not mathematical multiplication.
A separate controller field also arrives under the exact key A::x.
Probe token: A::x.
Unsupported basis: compound namespace keys are outside the symbol grammar and must not instantiate either a matrix-vector product or a continuous state equation.
Editing policy: definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are explicitly unavailable for A::x.

Declaration: ∇̃J denotes a custom filtered-gradient badge.
Probe statement: ∇̃J is visually suggestive but is not the ordinary gradient of an objective.
Unsupported basis: the decorated multi-codepoint badge is outside the supported symbol grammar and must not establish first-order stationarity.
Editing policy: definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are explicitly unavailable for ∇̃J.

Declaration: \theta denotes the trainable parameter.
Declaration: \alpha denotes step size.
Declaration: g denotes gradient.
Update law: \theta_+ = \theta - \alpha g.

Declaration: \theta denotes the trainable parameter.
Declaration: \alpha denotes step size.
Declaration: g denotes gradient.
Update law: \theta_+ = \theta - \alpha g.
Declaration: \theta denotes coolant temperature in the same scope.
Conflict note: the edit intentionally gives \theta two incompatible meanings.
Editing policy: the two positive declarations make definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename explicitly unavailable for \theta.

Declaration: V denotes voltage.
Declaration: I denotes current.
Declaration: R denotes resistance.
Law statement: V = I R.

Declaration: V denotes voltage.
Declaration: ⚡ denotes a transient-current pictograph.
Declaration: R denotes resistance.
Draft statement: V = ⚡ R.
Unsupported basis: the pictograph is not a plain Unicode letter or control sequence and must not instantiate Ohm's law.
Editing policy: definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are explicitly unavailable for ⚡.

Symbol declaration: V denotes the measured voltage across the resistor.
I denotes the measured branch current, and R denotes the calibrated resistance.

The source-note names are imported without aliases.
V = I R.

scenarios.genre: competing namespace declarations for a set operand

documents.content:
First scope declaration: shared_set denotes the admissible samples from run alpha.
backup_set denotes the retained samples.
Second scope declaration: shared_set denotes the admissible samples from run beta.

Both scope files are visible and neither has precedence.
union_result = shared_set ∪ backup_set.
Navigation refusal: shared_set is a multi-character identifier and also has two competing source declarations; definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are intentionally unavailable.

scenarios.genre: electrical and mechanical power namespace collision

documents.content:
Electrical scope declaration: power_reading denotes bus power.
Electrical model: power_reading = bus_voltage × branch_current.

Mechanical scope declaration: power_reading denotes shaft power.
Mechanical model: power_reading = shaft_force × shaft_velocity.
The integration record explicitly identifies both declarations as one shared power entity. At the same instant the bus record fixes power_reading at 80 W while the shaft record fixes it at 50 W, with no storage or loss term. These simultaneous values conflict.
Navigation refusal: power_reading is a multi-character collided identifier, so all navigation and rename surfaces are intentionally unavailable.

correctionSummary: Made the merged scopes explicitly identify one shared entity and added incompatible simultaneous values to ground the conflict.

scenarios.genre: linear map feeding a descent update

documents.content:
Symbol declaration: x denotes the current iterate.
A denotes the linear operator and b denotes its mapped result.
First link: b = A x.

The mapped result b is explicitly reviewed as the gradient input for the update.
Second link: y = x - eta b.

correctionSummary: Connected the mapped result to the update by using b as the explicitly reviewed gradient input.

scenarios.genre: mass flow feeding an unfinished momentum estimate

documents.content: Upstream measurement: mdot = rho A u.

The upstream mdot is imported.
Force estimate: drag_estimate = mdot × [velocity change pending].
The velocity-change term has not been supplied, so the second derivation link is incomplete.
Navigation refusal: drag_estimate is a multi-character identifier; definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are intentionally unavailable.

correctionSummary: Recorded the pending velocity-change placeholder as the incomplete catalog role in the second derivation link.

scenarios.genre: heat calculation feeding contradictory energy ledgers

documents.content: Thermal input link: Q = m c dT.

Symbol declaration: \DeltaU denotes the internal-energy change.
The heat input is imported from heat.txt.
First ledger says \DeltaU = Q - W.
Second ledger says \DeltaU = Q + W.
Both ledgers claim the same work sign convention, so they conflict.

scenarios.genre: hydrostatic relation with an explicit validity guard

documents.content:
Symbol declaration: h denotes the liquid-column height.
Guard: the liquid is static, density rho is uniform, and g is constant.
Under that guard, p = rho g h.

scenarios.genre: capacitor derivative with an unverified smoothness guard

documents.content:
Model statement: i_cap = C d(v_cap)/dt.
Guard status: differentiability of v_cap at the switching instant has not been established.
The relation is retained as a partial claim until that condition is proved.
Navigation refusal: i_cap is a multi-character identifier; definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are intentionally unavailable.

correctionSummary: Recorded the derivative time variable as the fourth catalog role.

documents.content:
Normal equation: X^T X alpha = X^T y.
Residual expression: r(t) = y(t) - X(t) alpha.
Objective expression: J(t) = r(t)^T r(t).
The editor then says 'differentiate it'; both immediately preceding expressions are differentiable and no cue selects one antecedent.
Navigation refusal: it is a discourse pronoun rather than a declared mathematical symbol; definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are intentionally unavailable.

correctionSummary: Placed two equally plausible differentiable expressions immediately before the unresolved pronoun.

scenarios.genre: cross-file definite description resolving a charge

documents.content: Symbol declaration: q denotes the test charge.

The test charge from the source file is the entity used below.
Force law: F = q E.

Positive declaration: T denotes absolute gas temperature.
Gas law: P V = n R T.

Positive declaration: T denotes signal period.
Signal law: f = 1 / T.
The signed integration record explicitly identifies both T declarations as one entity, while requiring it simultaneously to have absolute-temperature and time-period dimensions. Those requirements conflict.
Navigation refusal: T has two positive source declarations, so definition and references share unavailable status and prepare-rename and rename share unavailable status.

correctionSummary: Made the merged declarations explicitly denote one entity while assigning incompatible temperature and period dimensions.

documents.content:
Materials note: sigma_y = K epsilon_p^n is a strain-hardening rule, and no catalog law is asserted for it.
Navigation refusal: sigma_y is a multi-character identifier in an unsupported relation; definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are intentionally unavailable.

scenarios.genre: event operator deliberately distinct from union and intersection

documents.content: A and B denote events in the same probability space.

Unsupported event operator: event_mix = A XOR B.
XOR is stipulated to mean membership in exactly one operand, so this statement is neither the cataloged union relation nor the cataloged intersection relation.
Navigation refusal: event_mix is a multi-character identifier without a supported source declaration; all navigation and rename surfaces are intentionally unavailable.

scenarios.genre: flow formula made incomplete by an edit

documents.content:
Source declaration: flow_estimate denotes volumetric flow rate.
Complete draft: flow_estimate = area_pipe × velocity_mean.

Source declaration: flow_estimate denotes volumetric flow rate.
Edited draft: flow_estimate = area_pipe × [velocity pending].
The edit removed the velocity value and intentionally leaves the relation incomplete.
Navigation refusal: flow_estimate is a multi-character identifier; definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are intentionally unavailable.

correctionSummary: Recorded the edited velocity placeholder as the incomplete catalog role after retraction.

scenarios.genre: supported acceleration formula edited into an unsupported jerk formula

documents.content:
Source declaration: force_estimate denotes net force.
Initial draft: force_estimate = mass_body × accel_body.

Source declaration: force_estimate denotes the edited force-like quantity.
Edited draft: force_estimate = mass_body × jerk_body.
The edit explicitly replaces acceleration with jerk; no catalog law is asserted for the edited formula.
Navigation refusal: force_estimate is a multi-character identifier in an unsupported edited relation; all navigation and rename surfaces are intentionally unavailable.

scenarios.genre: duplicate state declaration introduced by an edit

documents.content:
Primary declaration: state_signal denotes the sampled plant state.
Update: state_next = A state_signal + B u.

Primary declaration: state_signal denotes the sampled plant state.
Imported duplicate declaration: state_signal denotes the sampled observer state.
Update: state_next = A state_signal + B u.
No precedence rule distinguishes the two declarations.
Navigation refusal: state_signal is a multi-character identifier with two positive declarations; definition, references, prepare-rename, and rename are intentionally unavailable.

In the load-loop scope, I_loop is the measured current and R_load is the load resistance.
V_drop = I_loop * R_load
The equality is asserted as Ohm's law for this load. Navigation and rename are unavailable for V_drop because it is a multi-character identifier rather than a one-character Unicode letter or a control sequence.
Project ledger: I_loop denotes load-loop current; R_load denotes load resistance; V_drop denotes the resulting voltage.

Scope Alpha calls the admissible set A_left; Scope Beta also calls a different admissible set A_left. The report does not select which scoped entity participates below. B_right is the shared exclusion set.
C_overlap = A_left intersection B_right
This is one set-intersection relation, but its left entity is ambiguous across the two scopes. Navigation and rename are unavailable for C_overlap because that spelling is a multi-character identifier.
Alpha declaration: A_left is the set of thermally admissible trials.
Beta declaration: A_left is the set of electrically admissible trials.
For the steady nozzle, rho_feed is density, area_feed is inlet area, speed_feed is inlet velocity, and delta_speed is outlet velocity minus inlet velocity.

First compute the mass flow rate.
mass_rate = rho_feed * area_feed * speed_feed
Then apply steady momentum flux.
thrust_force = mass_rate * delta_speed
Both displayed equalities are asserted for the same steady stream. Navigation and rename are unavailable for thrust_force because it is a multi-character identifier.

The calorimeter first establishes sensible_heat = sample_mass * sample_heat_capacity * delta_temp.
The resulting delta_temp feeds the plane-wall calculation. The sheet identifies k_wall as conductivity and area_wall as area, but never supplies wall length.
heat_rate = k_wall * area_wall * delta_temp / missing_length
missing_length is only a placeholder, not a grounded quantity or declaration, so the second link remains partial. Navigation and rename are unavailable for heat_rate because it is a multi-character identifier.

correctionSummary: Added a grounded sensible-heat upstream step whose temperature-change result feeds the incomplete wall-conduction step, and marked both authored relations source-grounded.

documents.content:
Use the following equality only while the sample is dilute, equilibrated, and treated as an ideal gas. The run log confirms all three conditions for run 12.
P_sample * V_sample = n_sample * R_const * T_sample
Here P_sample is pressure, V_sample volume, n_sample amount, R_const the gas constant, and T_sample absolute temperature. Navigation and rename are unavailable for P_sample because it is a multi-character identifier.
Run 12 status: dilute=yes; equilibrium=yes; ideal-gas approximation enabled=yes.

If the observed crest train is monochromatic at the probe, use the wave-speed relation below. The instrument report does not state whether the train is monochromatic, so the guard remains ungrounded.
wave_speed = probe_frequency * probe_wavelength
wave_speed is wave speed, probe_frequency is frequency, and probe_wavelength is wavelength. Navigation and rename are unavailable for wave_speed because it is a multi-character identifier.

correctionSummary: Distinguished an explicitly authored relation from incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting proof by marking the relation source-grounded.

documents.content:
The calculation asserts a hydrostatic column and uses rho_liquid as density, g_local as acceleration, and h_column as height.
column_pressure = rho_liquid * g_local * h_column
However, the same signed audit states that the liquid is not static and has an unmodeled vertical acceleration during this interval. The asserted hydrostatic guard and the recorded operating condition conflict. Navigation and rename are unavailable for column_pressure because it is a multi-character identifier.

correctionSummary: Distinguished an explicitly authored relation from incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting proof by marking the relation source-grounded.

documents.content: The calibration ledger declares q_test as the test charge and V_node as the electric voltage at the selected node.

Take the test charge from the ledger. Multiply it by that node voltage; the resulting electric potential energy is U_electric.
U_electric = q_test * V_node
The discourse descriptions and the displayed equality denote the same quantities. Navigation and rename are unavailable for U_electric because it is a multi-character identifier.

The operator records drive_force and brake_force, then writes 'use it' without saying which force the pronoun denotes. cart_velocity is the cart velocity.
shaft_power = it * cart_velocity
The line is one mechanical-power relation, but the force entity is ambiguous between drive_force and brake_force. Navigation and rename are unavailable for shaft_power because it is a multi-character identifier.

correctionSummary: Distinguished an explicitly authored relation from incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting proof by marking the relation source-grounded.

documents.content:
C_store is identified as capacitance. The next sentence says 'differentiate that signal,' but no earlier sentence identifies which voltage signal 'that signal' denotes.
charge_current = C_store * derivative(that_signal)
The current and capacitance roles are grounded, while the voltage role lacks a resolved discourse referent. Navigation and rename are unavailable for charge_current because it is a multi-character identifier.
Context lists two candidate traces, sensor_voltage and command_voltage, without selecting either one for the notebook entry.

correctionSummary: Distinguished the authored relation from incomplete discourse proof and recorded the unresolved voltage and time roles explicitly.

documents.content:
The electrical worksheet asserts supply_power as electrical power, bus_voltage as voltage, and load_current as current.
supply_power = bus_voltage * load_current
Navigation and rename are unavailable for supply_power because it is a multi-character identifier.

The authoritative namespace ledger instead declares supply_power to be a dimensionless software throttling level, explicitly not electrical power. This declaration conflicts with the worksheet's role assignment.

correctionSummary: Distinguished an explicitly authored relation from incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting proof by marking the relation source-grounded.

documents.content:
review_number is an editorial count of how many reviewers named Reynolds; it is not a Reynolds number and carries no density, velocity, length, or viscosity roles.
review_number = accepted_reviews + rejected_reviews
The matching surname is only lexical, so the catalog Reynolds-number definition is explicitly unsupported here. Navigation and rename are unavailable for review_number because it is a multi-character identifier.

The fixture describes a spring constitutive rule only.
spring_force = spring_stiffness * extension_amount
No catalog law listed for this task represents this spring rule, and the text does not assert any catalog relation. Navigation and rename are unavailable for spring_force because it is a multi-character identifier.

Initial draft: A_map is the sole operator and x_vec is the vector.
y_result = A_map * x_vec

Revised draft: the operator name A_map now refers to either calibration operator A_cal or projection operator A_proj; the editor has not chosen between them. x_vec remains the vector.
y_result = A_map * x_vec
This is one matrix-vector relation with an ambiguous operator entity. Navigation and rename are unavailable for y_result because it is a multi-character identifier.
Review at draft 2 confirms that A_cal and A_proj are distinct operators and that A_map has not been disambiguated.

Revision 1 models a discrete controller.
next_state = A_state * current_state + B_input * control_input
Revision 1 ledger: A_state is the state matrix; current_state is state; B_input is the input matrix; control_input is control input.

Revision 2 retains the asserted discrete update.
next_state = A_state * current_state + B_input * control_input
Navigation and rename are unavailable for next_state because it is a multi-character identifier.

Revision 2 signed ledger reclassifies A_state as an output matrix and explicitly says it is not the state matrix, while the model still assigns it the state-matrix role. The two current sources conflict.

correctionSummary: Distinguished an explicitly authored relation from incomplete, ambiguous, or conflicting proof by marking the relation source-grounded.

documents.content:
Version 1 discussed the union of event_left and event_right.
combined_event = event_left union event_right

Version 2 deletes the event-union assertion. combined_event is now only the name of a conference session, not an event or a mathematical result.
combined_event = morning_session_title
The previous probability meaning is explicitly withdrawn, so event union is unsupported in this snapshot. Navigation and rename are unavailable for combined_event because it is a multi-character identifier.
Change log: removed the probability event-union model and repurposed combined_event as prose metadata.
